pages.title: The Crownbreaker
pages.text: Forged for one purpose. We never got to use it.

While the Crown burns with ice, the citadel is the king's: his servants are stronger, the stone will not yield, and the cold never lets go.$(br2)Drive the wedge into it and its light changes colour - and from then on it burns for you. The stone, though, holds for as long as the king lives.
